quote.text:
Last night I dreamt of my old junior high, and it was close to Disneyland irl, btw. The dream showed me the demographic change that happened a few years after, where the school became predominantly hispanic. I was like "why am I reviewing this"? 

I hung out with all the groups, and drifted between them as bi-racial, but never fit neatly in one group. Sometimes the girl gangs that went to the school at the time, would try to pick on the cheerleaders, and I would intervene. It wasn't like I was the toughest girl there, but my bestfriend was lol, so everybody listened to me- cuz I could sic her on them like a bulldog. I didn't purposely befriend the toughest girl, I just understood her in a way nobody else did.
